description: This file defines the SugarWidgetSubPanelTopSelectContactsButton class, a PHP class that extends SugarWidgetSubPanelTopSelectButton. It is responsible for generating an HTML button that opens a popup to select contacts in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment. The class includes methods for constructing the widget, generating a widget ID, and rendering the HTML form and button with appropriate attributes and behaviors.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopSelectContactsButton
classes.description: A PHP widget class for rendering a contact selection button in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM subpanel interface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the widget with button properties.

methods.name: getWidgetId
methods.description: Returns a unique widget ID, appending '_select_button' to the parent's ID.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates and returns HTML for a button that opens a popup to select contacts, considering user permissions and widget data.
